content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fairfield

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, associate degree, or high school diploma affects your required hours of documented project experience. Granite PM Academy can help you assess whether you meet the prerequisites before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our PMI-approved curriculum covers all five process groups, knowledge areas, and exam domains over multiple sessions. Attend all live sessions to earn your required contact hours—a prerequisite for PMI application eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your formal education, create your PMI account and submit your PMP application directly to PMI. You'll document your project-management experience, education, and training hours. Pay the associated exam fee to PMI once your application is reviewed and approved.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources and practice assessments to reinforce concepts covered in class. Schedule your exam at a PMI-authorized testing center when you're ready. Our instructors remain available to clarify difficult topics as you finalize your readiness.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification is valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) by attending approved training, conferences, or relevant professional activities. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education options to help you meet renewal requirements and stay current in project-management practices.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
